_comment: Krea 2 Turbo text-to-image, from a GGUF transformer.
Derived from ComfyUI's own template image_krea2_turbo_t2i.json (its
subgraph 'Text to Image (Krea-2 Turbo)'), reduced to the sampling path:
the template's prompt-expansion chain (TextGenerate + switches) is UI
convenience, not part of the model, and llamanager sends the prompt the
UNETLoader is swapped for the ComfyUI-GGUF one; the text encoder stays a
CLIPLoader because Krea 2's conditioner ships as an fp8_scaled
safetensors, not a GGUF. Its loader type is 'krea2', not 'qwen_image' -
Krea 2 uses a Qwen3-VL 4B conditioner of its own.
Krea 2 Turbo is guidance-distilled: cfg is 1.0 and the negative branch is
a zeroed copy of the positive conditioning, which is what the reference
workflow does. There is no negative prompt to supply.
